confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief: radio says LH-02 is stopped at C512-04, but CMMS shows it operating. Confirm its real status. Nothing is moved for this place until then.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (15.4 g/t, 256 t, about 127 oz). The likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle for hours. LH-08 comes from the cheap preparacion heading (1.9 oz/h) and travels 0.53 h. It loads at 30 t/h for about 6.4 h, which is roughly 190 t or 95 oz. The heading loses about 13 oz, so the net is about 80 oz. Este trucks (72 t/h) can take the extra inflow (36 + 30 t/h). I did not take LH-09 because its critical-path heading is worth 4 oz/h. LH-10 is in PM until 11:00. LH-02 is left alone because radio and CMMS conflict (CONFIRM-01).
